description: Use this when someone wants to know what a Galápagos trip costs or needs a budget. Adds up the national park fee, transit control card, return flight from Quito or Guayaquil, an optional airport hotel night, hotels or a cruise, ferries, water taxis, the Isabela dock fee, day tours and food for the given days, travellers, style and islands. Returns every line, the total, per person and per person per day in US dollars, and shows a printed receipt card. All inputs are optional. Examples: "What does 8 days in the Galápagos cost for two people?" / "¿Cuánto cuesta un viaje de 8 días a Galápagos para dos personas?"

fly_from.description: Mainland airport for the flight to the islands (default quito).

islands.description: Land only: islands to sleep on, 1–3 (default 2: Santa Cruz and Isabela).

mainland_night.description: Add a hotel night near the mainland airport before the flight (default true).

mode.description: land (hotels and day tours, default) or cruise (live aboard).

nationality.description: Park fee group: foreign (default), canmercosur (CAN or Mercosur national) or resident (Ecuadorian or resident).

style.description: budget, mid (default) or upper (comfort hotels, luxury cruise).

tours.description: Land only: guided day tours per person (default 3).

name: estimate_trip_cost

link.description: Page on galapagosislands.info with these inputs filled in.

title: Galápagos trip cost
